description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `LeaveEntitlementTest` for testing the `LeaveEntitlement` entity within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes test setup, a data provider, and a test method to verify leave entitlement calculations.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the `LeaveEntitlement` entity testing leave entitlement functionalities within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating specific tables before each test.

methods.name: testLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Tests the setting and retrieval of leave entitlement data, verifying the number of days and days used.

methods.name: leaveEntitlementDataProvider
methods.description: Provides different sets of leave entitlement data for parameterized testing.
